verdict: A costly week: Google spend rose while leads dropped sharply.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 10 leads on $2,414 in total spend, with cost per lead rising 128% week-over-week to $241. The primary driver is Google Ads — one campaign alone consumed $1,604 of your Google budget while delivering very few conversions, meaning that channel is spending without producing proportional results. We are restructuring that campaign to stop the budget drain and improve efficiency. Separately, your Google Business Profile engagement fell 68% week-over-week, removing the organic buffer that had been softening paid costs; monitoring is active on that front as well. With those two corrections in motion, cost per lead should begin to come down over the next reporting period.

watch_item.issue: One Google campaign is consuming the majority of your ad budget without generating proportional leads, driving cost per lead to an unsustainable level.
watch_item.fix: That campaign is being restructured this week to reallocate spend toward placements that are actually converting.
